# Check CONTEXT info
info = CONTEXT.info()
print(info)

# Read the full diff output
results = await CONTEXT.search("diff --git a/host")
for r in results['items']:
    chunk = await CONTEXT.read(max(0, r['offset'] - 50), 5000)
    print(f"--- diff at offset {r['offset']}, len={len(chunk)} ---")
    print(chunk[:3000])
    
# Also search for the exact repr line in the diff
results2 = await CONTEXT.search("repr")
for r in results2['items']:
    chunk = await CONTEXT.read(max(0, r['offset'] - 200), 400)
    print(f"--- repr at offset {r['offset']} ---")
    print(chunk)
